name: Battle Rope Alternating Wave
steps: Stand facing an anchored battle rope with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent in an athletic stance, and one end gripped in each hand.
Brace your core tightly, keep your chest lifted, and hold slight slack in both ropes.
Drive one arm rapidly upward while whipping the opposite arm down to send steady alternating waves toward the anchor.
Maintain a brisk, continuous alternating rhythm for the target duration, then slow down and lower both ends.
tips: Keep moderate slack in the rope so smooth waves can travel all the way to the anchor.
Stay low and steady through your hips rather than bouncing your entire body up and down.
